messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] rNOMADS update fixes error when subsetting grib files on windows machines
messages.subject_clean: [Rnomads-user] rNOMADS update fixes error when subsetting grib files on windows machines
messages.body_plain:
Hi All,


I have just released rNOMADS 2.1.7, which is a minor update that fixes an error that occurs when using the "domain" argument in the ReadGrib function on Windows machines.  An alert user noticed the problem and suggested a fix, which I just implemented.


If you anticipate using rNOMADS on Windows, I recommend downloading the new version.  The binary should be on CRAN within 48 hours or so.


Best,


Danny

messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] Download old GFS of 0.25 degree
messages.body_plain:
Hi Santiago,


rNOMADS has the ability to retrieve archived 0.5 x 0.5 degree GFS model runs, but I do not believe NOMADS has made the 0.25 x 0.25 degree archive available.


For example, to get the archived 0.5 degree model for January 1st at 00z, do this:

library(rNOMADS)

abbrev <- "gfs4"

model.date <- "20160101"

model.run   <- "00"

pred             <- "00"

grb.info <- ArchiveGribGrab(abbrev, model.date, model.run, pred, file.type = "grib2")


Best,


Danny
